summary: Two tabs shown side by side in a split view within the same window.
description: A wrapper that holds exactly two tabs shown side-by-side in a split view. A classic XUL custom element with no internal template or shadow root; its only real content is the two wrapped <tab> elements.

attributes.name: hasactivetab
attributes.description: Reflects whether one of the two wrapped tabs is currently active; drives internal activate()/suspend() behavior.

attributes.name: multiselected
attributes.description: Get-only in this file; set externally by multi-select code elsewhere.

attributes.name: splitViewId
attributes.description: Mixed-case attribute holding a numeric session-restore identity for the split view, exposed via the state getter.

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.description: Toggled based on the visible getter; watched by the element's own subtree MutationObserver.

attributes.name: dragtarget
attributes.description: External-only hook: referenced in tabs.css for drag styling but never set or read inside this file; managed by drag-and-drop code elsewhere.

slots.name: (default)
slots.description: Exactly two tab elements (the two tabs being viewed side-by-side), added/removed via addTabs()/unsplitTabs()/replaceTab(). No static template or shadow DOM.

events.name: SplitViewTabChange
events.description: Dispatched on this element (bubbles) from a mutation-observer callback whenever the child-tab composition changes and at least one tab remains. tab-group.js listens for this event.

events.name: SplitViewRemoved
events.description: Dispatched on this.container (gBrowser.tabContainer), bubbles and composed, in disconnectedCallback.

events.name: TabSplitViewActivate
events.description: Dispatched on this.container; detail: {tabs, splitview: this}; fired from the private #activate() method.

events.name: TabSplitViewDeactivate
events.description: Dispatched on this.container; detail: {tabs, splitview: this}; fired from both real teardown (#deactivate()) and temporary hide-while-switching (#suspend()) — same event name covers both cases.

methods.name: unsplitTabs
methods.description: trigger values: menu_separate | icon_separate | icon_close | tab_close | footer_separate

cssProperties.name: --split-view-padding-block
cssProperties.description: Block padding of the split view (default 2px), set in tabs.css.

cssProperties.name: --split-view-tab-padding-inline
cssProperties.description: Inline padding of each split-view tab (default 2px), set in tabs.css.
